description: Lightweight evaluation rubric for render-right route classification accuracy
scoring: 1 point per correct recommendedStrategy. Partial credit: PPR vs ISR edge cases expected to vary.

cases.description: Pure marketing landing page with no data fetching
cases.notes: No dynamic data — CDN forever is correct, zero function cost

cases.description: Blog post page fetching from a CMS with explicit revalidation
cases.notes: Already using ISR correctly — should be marked optimal

cases.description: User dashboard that reads an auth cookie
cases.notes: cookies() makes this unavoidably dynamic — SSR is correct

cases.description: Product detail page fetching from DB with no caching specified
cases.notes: No cache directive in Next.js 15 means no-store (SSR on every request) — should add revalidate

cases.description: Search results page driven by query parameters
cases.notes: searchParams access forces SSR in Next.js 15 — correct but Edge could reduce latency

cases.description: Product page with static info and a Suspense-wrapped recommendations widget
cases.notes: Classic PPR candidate: static shell + dynamic island in Suspense

cases.description: Geo-personalized page already using edge runtime
cases.notes: Already correctly using Edge for geo-personalization — should be marked optimal

cases.description: Static about page incorrectly forced to SSR with force-dynamic
cases.notes: force-dynamic on static content is a costly mistake — every visit hits a function
